info.name: Tutoring marketplace — Lab 4 + 5 API
info.description:
CSS-3008 Labs 4 and 5: lessons, the error record, actuator, OpenAPI, and the Lab 5 security rules.

Start the app with `docker compose up -d` and `mvn spring-boot:run` (dev profile), then run the whole collection in order (Runner). Folder 0 logs in as the dev-only users aliya / student-dev (STUDENT) and dana / tutor-dev (TUTOR) and stores studentToken and tutorToken as collection variables. Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{studentToken}}` unless it says otherwise: the open endpoints use No Auth, and the confirm requests use tutorToken. No request prints a token.
